name: vibe
doc: Mistral Vibe: account default model, no model flag, no local sandbox (the two flags below are full access). Small free tier: mostly a reviewer from another vendor.

usage.note: monthly Vibe budget and plan from Mistral's billing API (/v1/billing/budget, /v1/billing/subscription) through Vibe's own Python and sign-in; no model call

tokens.note: Mistral Vibe keeps no token counts in its session store (only the context size); see /usage in an interactive session

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
